title: Coming up in May, June, and July
excerpt: Friends in Maine! I'll be speaking in Portland, May 3, 4, and 5. Saturday May 3: A World Unraveling – join me for a deep dive into our current situation and how we can show up with wisdom, courage, and love. Sunday May 4: I'll be preaching at St. Alban's Episcopal morning and…
body:
Friends in Maine! I'll be speaking in Portland, May 3, 4, and 5.

Saturday May 3: [A World Unraveling](https://episcopalmaine.org/event/a-world-unraveling-a-day-with-brian-mclaren/) – join me for a deep dive into our current situation and how we can show up with wisdom, courage, and love.

Sunday May 4: I'll be preaching at [St. Alban's Episcopal](https://www.stalbansmaine.org/) morning and evening.

Monday May 5: I'll be speaking to the [Episcopal clergy of Maine](https://episcopalmaine.org/event/save-the-dates-for-clergy-conference-2025/2025-05-05/) at St. Luke's Episcopal.

Friends everywhere – Online, Saturday May 17, with Fr. John Dear

Available everywhere: I'll be spending 90 minutes online with my joyfully nonviolent friend Fr. John Dear on May 17 – 2-3:30 pm ET, via the [Beatitudes Center](https://beatitudescenter.org/). We get to speak about my favorite subject of all – Jesus and his transformative message.

Friends in Michigan (and beyond)

I'll be at [Bay View Chautauqua](https://www.bayviewassociation.org/bay-view-a-chautauqua-on-lake-michigan/), June 22-26 speaking on Four Twentieth-Century Theologians the Twenty-First Century Desperately Needs.

Friends of Open and Relational Theology:

I will be joining the wise and wonderful Dr. Tom Oord and the great and growing [ORT community](https://c4ort.com/ortcon/) in wild and beautiful Wyoming which takes place June 30 – July 4. (I'll be there Monday – Wednesday).

Friends in Campus Ministry:

I'll be with the [UMCMA](https://www.umcma.org/) in Dallas July 15-17.

Friends in Alaska!

I'm making my first ever visit to Alaska to join the Alaska School of Theology, July 18-19. My topic will be “Dancing on a Moving Floor: Christian Leadership in an Ever-Changing Landscape.”

I hope to see you this summer!
